title: mesh-join-card/1 — record schema (Home-2 semantics)
description: Validates the `card` object carried at model_attestation.compute_attestation['x-mesh-join-card-v1'].card of a sealed capsule (capsule-emit-mesh join_card.py). This schema covers ONLY the semantic content of the card -- the mechanical capsule envelope around it (capsule_id, signature, canonicalization) is Home-1/CPB's concern and is checked by agent-action-capsule verify, not here.

measurement_rung.description: Closed set (open_questions in mesh-join-card.yaml flags whether a third rung is needed): 'reported' (self-reported, unverified) or 'os_measured' (captured via an OS-level measurement path, e.g. system_profiler).
